alt: A flat lay arrangement of craft items and tech accessories on a light grey dotted background. Visible objects include rolls of green, pink, and yellow paper, translucent blue and orange cubes, marbles, purple and yellow Lego pieces, and a white game.
caption: A collection of craft supplies and building blocks arranged with a white game controller on a dotted background.
description: A top-down view of a white surface covered with various colorful objects. The scene includes rolls of green and pink construction paper, translucent blue and orange cubes, and spherical marbles. A white video game controller with blue, red, green, and yellow buttons sits in the lower left corner.
